title: Top secret files from the late 1800s
summary: Steven Greer tells of Top secret files from the late 1800s, about late 1800s-early 1900s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Late 1800s, early 1900s. There are still top secret files on this issue from the late 1800s and early 1900s. We know this.

plain: Steven Greer, a UFO activist who campaigns for government openness, said on Jesse Michels' podcast that a senior CIA source he does not name told him about very old secrets. According to Greer, there are still top secret US government files about UFOs dating from the late 1800s and early 1900s. If true, it would mean the government was watching this subject before airplanes even existed.
